about: Held-out questions, written after the retrieval changes in PROOF.md were chosen with evals/questions.json, so they were never used for tuning. Same format and scoring as questions.json.

questions.question: What does Jane mean when she says she is no bird and no net ensnares her?
gold: I am no bird; and no net ensnares me

questions.question: What does Lord Henry say is the only way to get rid of a temptation?
gold: The only way to get rid of a temptation is to yield to it

questions.question: Why does the Cheshire Cat say we're all mad here?
gold: we’re all mad here. I’m mad. You’re mad.

questions.question: How does Ishmael survive after the Pequod goes down?
gold: Buoyed up by that coffin, for almost one whole day and night

questions.question: How does Darcy open his first declaration of love to Elizabeth?
gold: In vain have I struggled. It will not do.

questions.question: What image does Nick leave us with in the very last line?
gold: So we beat on, boats against the current

questions.question: Hiding in a hovel, a lonely being spies on a poor family through a gap in the wall. What does he see?
gold: small and almost imperceptible chink through which the eye could just penetrate

questions.question: A man stopped at the altar admits that his secret wife is insane. What does he say about her family?
gold: she came of a mad family; idiots and maniacs through three generations

questions.question: In a dream, a drunken peasant beats his old horse to death in front of a crowd. What does he shout?
gold: I feel as if I could kill her

questions.question: What name does the young Marquis go by while he lives in England?
gold: he is no Marquis there; he is Mr. Charles Darnay
questions.confuser: Charles Bingley in Pride and Prejudice

questions.question: How did Jo first meet the boy next door at the New Year's party?
gold: she slipped into a curtained recess

questions.question: What did the Queen use for croquet mallets and balls?
gold: the balls were live hedgehogs, the mallets live flamingoes
